name: Euclidean
brief: Euclidean rhythm generator distributing hits evenly across steps.
description:
Uses the Bjorklund algorithm to space a given number of hits as evenly
as possible across a step count. Rotation shifts the pattern start point.
tips: 3 hits in 8 steps gives the classic tresillo rhythm. 5 in 8 gives a cinquillo.

params.name: hits
params.doc: Number of active steps in the pattern.

params.name: rotation
params.doc: Rotates the pattern by N steps.
